Farmacias Kielsa
is a major Central American retail pharmacy chain founded around 2009 (with over 17 years of regional operation) and headquartered in Tegucigalpa, Honduras. It operates a vast network of retail drugstores, integrated clinics, and laboratories offering prescription medicines, dermocosmetics, baby care, natural wellness products, and convenience items.
Google Play
What the Company Does
Operates retail pharmacy storefronts and e-commerce delivery across Honduras, Nicaragua, Guatemala, and Costa Rica.
Provides in-house clinical health services, medical consultations, and laboratory testing.
www.kielsaclinica.com

Farmacias Kielsa
is operated by Kielsa Farmacéutica under
Grupo Farinter
, stocking major international skin care, health, and wellness brands alongside trusted regional pharmaceutical and manufacturing partners.
